messages.subject: Installation- ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘methylKit’

When I tried to install methylkit by following the easy installation described on site https://code.google.com/p/methylkit/#Installation , I had the following error : ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘methylKit’ (see below for more detail).

Could you help me to solve this ? 

Thanks in advance.
Emilie

messages.author: 4dff9aa5198ce4c4
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Installation- ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘methylKit’
parts:
Finaly I used the command lines :
source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("XVector")

And now the installation is done.
Thanks for your quick answer
